name: universal_story
series: Stories of the Ummah or any historical world
title: Replace with a verified story title
source: Required: cite and verify the primary source, translation, or historical record before publication.

story.era: Set the real or imagined timeline.
content_boundaries: Do not depict prophets or sacred figures directly

characters.policy: Use faceless or respectful silhouettes for sacred and historical subjects. Do not generate a prophet's face or claim an invented likeness.

audio.narration: Use a clear, respectful documentary voice from the verified script and never imitate a real reciter.
audio.music: Use only license-cleared ambient music or environmental sound matched to the era and mood.
audio.mix: Keep narration dominant, duck music 8-12 dB during speech, target -3 dBFS narration peak, leave headroom, and check clipping.
audio.delivery: AAC 192-256 kbps stereo; target -16 to -14 LUFS integrated where the platform permits

seo.title: Verified story title + series/episode
seo.description: Summary, source note, timestamps, reflection, and disclosure.

scenes.subtitle: Open with a specific hook.
scenes.vo: Open with a specific hook grounded in the verified story.

scenes.subtitle: Introduce the central test.
scenes.vo: Introduce the central test without adding unsupported details.

scenes.subtitle: Show the moral choice.
scenes.vo: Show the moral choice and distinguish sourced facts from reflection.

scenes.subtitle: End with the lesson and source note.
scenes.vo: End with a concise reflection and remind viewers to verify the source before sharing.
